SELECT Trim$(nz([pname]))+" "+Trim$(nz([fname])) AS name, Trim$(nz([address])) & " " & Trim$(nz([area])) AS waddress, Trim$(nz([city])) AS wcity, cust_list.wsort
FROM cust_list

INSERT INTO tb_qnum ( qnum )
SELECT tb_q_catalog_melai.wnum
FROM ((tb_q_catalog_melai INNER JOIN q_melai_p_date ON tb_q_catalog_melai.qsmodel = q_melai_p_date.MD) INNER JOIN q_melai_p_date_sum ON tb_q_catalog_melai.qsmodel = q_melai_p_date_sum.MD) LEFT JOIN SAPAKIM ON tb_q_catalog_melai.sapak = SAPAKIM.[CODE SAPAK]
GROUP BY tb_q_catalog_melai.wnum, SAPAKIM.[SHEM SAPAK], xg_ReplaceAllWith((Trim$(nz([hevra]))),"'",""""), xg_ReplaceAllWith((Trim$(nz([degem]))),"'",""""), xg_ReplaceAllWith((Trim$(nz([godel]))),"'",""""), xg_ReplaceAllWith((Trim$(nz([color]))),"'",""""), nz([sapak]) & xg_ReplaceAllWith((Trim$(nz([hevra])) & Trim$(nz([degem])) & Trim$(nz([godel])) & Trim$(nz([color]))),"'","""") & [ws], q_melai_p_date.DT, q_melai_p_date.t
HAVING (((q_melai_p_date.DT)>=IIf(nz([Forms]![s_melai]![fwdate])="",#1/1/1980#,[Forms]![s_melai]![fwdate]) And (q_melai_p_date.DT)<=IIf(nz([Forms]![s_melai]![twdate])="",#1/1/3000#,[Forms]![s_melai]![twdate])) AND ((q_melai_p_date.t)="מ"))
ORDER BY nz([sapak]) & xg_ReplaceAllWith((Trim$(nz([hevra])) & Trim$(nz([degem])) & Trim$(nz([godel])) & Trim$(nz([color]))),"'","""") & [ws], q_melai_p_date.DT;
